title: I used Cursor to generate this helicopter rescue game
author: invertedworld
selftext:
I did not write a single line of code, I just told it what to do and gave feedback. The assets (helicopter model and sounds) I found online.

[https://invertedworld.itch.io/heli-hero](https://invertedworld.itch.io/heli-hero)

Feedback / questions welcome!

comments.author: OraznatacTheBrave
comments.body: Nice job! The controls were fun and easy to use. The loading pops as you moved were a bit distracting. I would include more refueling opportunities in proximity to my location.  And then some simple objectives, like rescuing people from locations, etc. Fun stuff tho!

replies.author: invertedworld
replies.body: Thank you! You can trigger a rescue mission by pressing H. Also look out for floating balloons high up near the clouds, full of fuel!

comments.author: TheRealErikMalkavian
comments.body:
Its a good starter game. It needs a speed indicator and more information on the position of the hikers.  You can't just go flying blinding with limited fuel.

Thanks for sharing this invertedworld

replies.author: invertedworld
replies.body:
Thank you for your feedback!

The hikers are shown as  a red dot on the radar, and you can press 5 to point straight to them. There is also a red smoke signal visible from some distance away as you get closer. 

I am not sure speed indicator would add much, this is supposed to be a fun game not a simulation. How would it help with gameplay? Why not an altimeter too?

replies.author: TheRealErikMalkavian
replies.body:
A Speed Indicator would add something because it would allow the player to figure how far they can travel before running out of fuel.

Its a game and no one likes to lose because of lack of information.  That's what I saw without a Speed Indicator.

Peace!

replies.author: invertedworld
replies.body: How would you use the speed information? The fuel lasts exactly 3 minutes regardless of how fast you travel or how high. I find I can judge it pretty well based on the amount remaining. Did you discover the fuel balloons?

replies.author: TheRealErikMalkavian
replies.body:
Since you want to continue the conversation and I want to END it, this is what you need to add if you are not going to add an speed indicator.

A method using GPS to see whether Helicopters fuel amount is even able to reach the hikers and if not, add in bases where it can land on the way or increase the fuel tank size or decrease its fuel usage.

I'm out and have a good night / day (Whereever you are in the World)
